why: Private motel with RV sites but no RV price anywhere (read 2026-11-22): its own Wix site (lakeviewmotelandcampground.com: Home/Amenities/Rooms/Contact) lists only 'Free WiFi / Campground Shower Facilities' with no RV sites, rates or count; the town lodging page (pollocksouthdakota.org/lodging) describes motel rooms and 'campground shower facilities' only; its WebRez engine (secure.webrez.com/property/3145) offers motel-room filters only and stops at a Cloudflare 'Verifying you are human' check (not bypassed); no RV Life listing (Algolia, 15 km: only West Pollock SRA x2 and Lake Pocasse) -> no price indicator for an RV night (precedent 5842).
name: Lakeview Motel & Campground
flags: The RV park is real but unpriced: an RVParkStore for-sale listing (ID 6965520, 99 SD Highway 10, Pollock; posted 2025-08-16, updated 2025-12-10, now 'Expired') describes a 10-room motel 'Originally built and operated as a motel' plus 'a 15-site RV park with full hookups for each site. The park also has a shower house and a laundry building'. It frames the property as a lodge/hunting retreat or private residence for sale; whether nights are still sold to RVers, and at what price, is not stated anywhere current.

Presence is weak too: the operator's own site has a phone (701-258-8881, a ND number; matches Google) but never mentions RV sites, only campground showers (lesson p3-562: a motel RV park whose own site never mentions RV sites may fail presence).

Google Maps (headless gm.py, 2026-11-22): 'Lakeview Motel & Campground', 99 SD-10, Pollock, 3.9 stars / 9 reviews, a lodging panel shared with the motel - under 25 reviews, so not a presence indicator on its own, and the rating is the motel's.

Not a duplicate: 5878 Pollock Town Park (East) is the town's donation park (~0.8 km NW of the Google point; town page: four 110 V hookups, $10 suggested donation) and 5743 West Pollock RA is GFP's, ~4 km SW. Nothing else in the DB within 15 km.

Imagery at the Google point (45.89900,-100.28200, Esri, rendered 2026-11-22, 300 m frame): a small house on a mown lot by SD-10 with a grain elevator south; no clear row of RV pads or motel block in frame - the pin may be imprecise, not pursued since the lead fails on price.
Only a phone call could settle RV rates and nightly sale; calls were out of scope.
